review:
Potion Spells mixes slots with match-3 games on a 7x7 grid of refilling reels. Five or more identical symbols touching vertically or horizontally form a cluster.

There are plenty of extras. Big symbols double the win of any cluster they join, backlit symbols leave wilds behind, and a Second Chance can rescue an unsuccessful spin. Each winning symbol also lowers a progress counter by one, and every 25 symbols activates another feature. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 12,000x maximum and a 96.3% RTP. Free spins land about once every 380 spins. It's the forerunner of Pop Zen and Gangsterz, with a magical potion theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
